policy.input: Original frozen V02 bridge-v2 BSP/public geometry/train/validation/heldout; no rebake or repartition

proposal_comparison.new_axes: one original brightness-centroid seed and one brightness-weighted receiver-normal seed per position; both historical 128/64 target/radius; no answer axis
proposal_comparison.refinement: up to four unique positions per kind, eight shared slots; same 384-node/ray/call/memory caps, kind round robin

catalog.selection: training shape-score ranks within source-kind and shard; round-robin shard/kind tickets; geometry plausibility checked by Joint
catalog.merge: same candidate identity only; spatially nearby proposals remain alternatives with unknown source identity
catalog.point_spot_family: same sampled pose as numerical type alternative, not certified lamp identity
catalog.finite: Exact original planar faces; full-edge, same-material connectivity gives separate conditional assembly alternatives, never a global glow family. Full nonplanar prism remains unsupported.
catalog.profiles: inverse-square and linear evaluated separately, never concatenated source energies

joint.heldout: same frozen V02 geometry and values; only score once model parameters freeze

admission.prism_recall: Separate unsupported source-kind coverage, never counted in three-local-root success

policy.previous_revision: v5 numerical search unchanged; after Solve freezes, at most three alternatives in existing validation order receive full parameter export and independent final diagnostic predictions. No held-out model reselection.
policy.previous_revision_joint: v2 16-kind catalog entered 77-81 models before mandatory 12M ray limit; all budget failures retained
policy.revised_schedule: Coarse bounded two-sweep nonlinear fits for all source alternatives; same strict reevaluation and independent acceptance; incomplete amplitude convergence stays partial
policy.additional_ablation: Export legacy4 and legacy8 exact historical target/radius with the new read-only adapter, to separate refinement budget from normal-axis benefit
policy.baseline_adapter_scope: Frozen old binary reproduces V02; legacy4 current binary reproduces geometry but preserves omitted old spot recipe values for fair downstream kind comparison

frozen_diagnostics.order: Existing validation order before final targets

direct.prism: Exact planar-face alternatives only; no complete multipart source model/count calibration
